title: Beaufort Learning Harbor v10.38
notes: Adds an adult-only Family/Co-op Planner with a Monday-Friday board, learner and track filters, catch-up/flex modes, optional co-op responsibilities, non-destructive assignment and lesson-pack seeding, linked carryover, deterministic fail-closed planner packages, adult workflow shortcuts, and Director readiness rollups. Planner actions do not complete work, grant rewards, record attendance, approve mastery, or change source records.
